title.en: Object pronouns: me, him, her, them
title.sl: Object pronouns (zaimki kot predmet): me, him, her, them
title.de: Object pronouns (Objektpronomen): me, him, her, them
title.it: Object pronouns (pronomi complemento): me, him, her, them

rule.en:
After a verb, a pronoun takes its object form: **me**, **you**, **him**, **her**, **it**, **us**, **them**. **Can you help me?** **Jack knows her.** **I can see them.** After a preposition too: **with me**, **for him**, **next to her**, **to us**, **from them**.

The subject comes before the verb, the object after it: **She likes him.** **He likes her.** **We know them.** **They know us.**

**her** is the object and the possessive: **I know her.** **It's her dog.** But **him** is never **his**: **I can see him.** (his is the possessive: **his dog**).

**it** is for a thing or an animal, **them** for more things, animals or people: **The keys? I've got them.** A pet with a name is **him** or **her**: **Meg? Jack loves her.**

After **be**, and alone, English says **me**: **Who is it? — It's me.** **I'm hungry. — Me too.**

One pronoun is enough: **Jack? I know him.** (never *I know him Jack*). With give: **Give me the key.** **Give it to me.**
rule.sl:
Za glagolom ima zaimek obliko za predmet: **me** (mene, me, meni), **you** (tebe, vas), **him** (njega, ga), **her** (njo, jo), **it** (ga, jo), **us** (nas), **them** (njih, jih). **Can you help me?** (Mi lahko pomagaš?) **Jack knows her.** (Jack jo pozna.) Za predlogom tudi: **with me** (z mano), **for him** (zanj), **next to her** (zraven nje), **to us**, **from them**.

Ena oblika za vse sklone: **him** je njega, ga, njemu, mu in z njim. Stoji vedno za glagolom: **I know him.** (Poznam ga.), nikoli *I him know*.

Osebek je pred glagolom, predmet za njim: **She likes him.** (Ona ima rada njega.) **He likes her.** (On ima rad njo.)

**her** je predmet in svojilni zaimek: **I know her.** (Poznam jo.) **It's her dog.** (To je njen pes.) **him** pa ni nikoli **his** (njegov): **I can see him.**

**it** je za stvar ali žival, **them** za več stvari, živali ali ljudi: **The keys? I've got them.** (Ključi? Pri meni so.) Žival z imenom je **him** ali **her**: **Meg? Jack loves her.**

**It's me.** (Jaz sem.) **Me too.** (Jaz tudi.) En zaimek je dovolj: **Jack? I know him.** **Give it to me.** (Daj mi ga.)
rule.de:
Nach einem Verb steht ein Pronomen in der Objektform: **me** (mich, mir), **you** (dich, dir, euch, Sie), **him** (ihn, ihm), **her** (sie, ihr), **it** (es), **us** (uns), **them** (sie, ihnen). **Can you help me?** (Kannst du mir helfen?) **Jack knows her.** (Jack kennt sie.) Nach einer Präposition auch: **with me** (mit mir), **for him** (für ihn), **next to her** (neben ihr), **to us**, **from them**.

Eine Form für Akkusativ und Dativ: **him** ist ihn und ihm, **them** sie und ihnen.

Das Subjekt steht vor dem Verb, das Objekt danach: **She likes him.** (Sie mag ihn.) **He likes her.** (Er mag sie.)

**her** ist Objekt und Possessiv: **I know her.** (Ich kenne sie.) **It's her dog.** (Das ist ihr Hund.) **him** ist aber nie **his** (sein): **I can see him.**

**it** steht für ein Ding oder ein Tier, **them** für mehrere Dinge, Tiere oder Leute: **The keys? I've got them.** (Die Schlüssel? Ich habe sie.) Ein Haustier mit Namen ist **him** oder **her**: **Meg? Jack loves her.**

**It's me.** (Ich bin's.) **Me too.** (Ich auch.) Ein Pronomen reicht: **Jack? I know him.** **Give it to me.** (Gib es mir.)
rule.it:
Dopo il verbo il pronome prende la forma di complemento: **me** (mi, me), **you** (ti, te, vi), **him** (lo, gli, lui), **her** (la, le, lei), **it** (lo, la), **us** (ci, noi), **them** (li, le, loro). **Can you help me?** (Mi puoi aiutare?) **Jack knows her.** (Jack la conosce.) Anche dopo una preposizione: **with me** (con me), **for him** (per lui), **next to her** (accanto a lei), **to us**, **from them**.

Il pronome va dopo il verbo: **I know him.** (Lo conosco.), mai *I him know*.

Il soggetto va prima del verbo, il complemento dopo: **She likes him.** (Lui le piace.) **He likes her.** (Lei gli piace.)

**her** è complemento e possessivo: **I know her.** (La conosco.) **It's her dog.** (È il suo cane.) Ma **him** non è mai **his** (suo): **I can see him.**

**it** è per una cosa o un animale, **them** per più cose, animali o persone: **The keys? I've got them.** (Le chiavi? Ce le ho io.) Un animale con un nome è **him** o **her**: **Meg? Jack loves her.**

**It's me.** (Sono io.) **Me too.** (Anch'io.) Basta un pronome: **Jack? I know him.** **Give it to me.** (Dammelo.)
